_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes:
Smart Cuff Default v3.1.272

SysID now measures HIGH, performs useful LOW measurements during exposure recovery, then measures MID after any remaining verified venting. On the final larger-cuff bench run, 217.063 seconds of LOW acquisition cleared the 198.42-second conservative exposure bound; additional vented wait was 2.110 seconds. This replaces the unnecessary fixed five-minute idle pause while retaining the firmware's 300-second safety limit, the host's 260-second probe margin and fresh continuous pump-off/vented evidence.

Discovery and three independent response checks per band use comparable pressure, a closed-valve approach and pump-off acquisition. Fine backfill measures active transitions before defining boundaries. The final crossing pass recognizes adjacent measured duties even when coarse/fine acquisition revisits them out of order. Invented boundaries and synthesized gains cannot pass the final measurement, PID apply, snapshot or offline trust gates. Result text distinguishes acquisition from accepted tuning and shows repeat errors, useful LOW time, remaining venting and the original rejection reason.

Fresh larger-cuff run117 passed measurement quality and offline SysID trust:

| Band | Independent checks | Maximum rate error (mmHg/s) | Measured gain |
|---|---|---:|---:|
| HIGH | PASS | 0.366 | 0.893 |
| MID | PASS | 0.205 | 0.677 |
| LOW | PASS | 0.332 | 0.503 |

Arduino parsed sequence delivery: 100.0%, zero missing sequence IDs. All 340,200 native NI samples were retained with zero timestamp backtracks. One malformed native serial row and 56 pre-reference unmapped rows remain separately recorded. This was comparison-only: no firmware tuning, calibration or accepted snapshot changed.

Historical small-cuff runs94-96 were replayed with the current rate fitter on original acquisition data. They supplied 13, 14 and 15 usable reconstructed HIGH windows, respectively, but stopped before MID/LOW and contain no independent held-out checks. Missing original worker-window records prevent an exact historical worker replay. Different pressures and approach histories prevent a cross-cuff tuning-transfer claim. These results do not establish 1000-device manufacturing yield.

The general recording-review calibration check remains FAIL on run117. That checker carries NI values forward by file order and treats small adjacent pressure changes as steady state. Separate native pump-off sealed plateaus gave identity MAE 0.521 mmHg and p95 1.308 mmHg; that bounded evidence does not qualify calibration or erase the original failure. No coefficients or NI acquisition timestamps changed.

Validation: Default frozen-source preflight 13/13 gates, 1356 tests passed and 6 skipped. Valinor final frozen-source preflight 13/13, 1205 passed and 5 skipped. Both layout audits CLEAN; actual Qt smoke tests caught no exceptions. The measured-boundary regression and final Valinor focused checks pass. Firmware rev27v-followup-242 is unchanged from its protected-flashed and soaked profile; Default retains its five clinical presets, 4 mmHg/s SysID reference and GUI/standalone parity.

The complete branch-specific application includes app-local Python and Arduino tooling, verified automatic updates and offline startup. Calibration history remains preserved. Fleet distribution requires individual Issues-only enrollment, maintainer review and verified application releases; no shared publishing credential or workstation flash receipt is bundled.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
